summary: Taste, smell, vision and self motion wired to the descending neurons that steer, walk, reverse and escape, and to the proboscis motor neuron MN9. The shared circuit of the Fly Gym tasks.
dataset: Subcircuit of FlyWire v783: inputs HSE, HSN, HSS, LPLC1, LC4, LPLC2, LC16, ORN_DM1, ORN_DA2, sugar/water, bitter; outputs DNa01, DNa02, DNa03, DNb05, DNa11, DNp01, MDN, DNp09, DNg13, DNp03, CB0701; paths with at least 40 synapses per step
license: FlyWire connectome v783, CC BY-NC 4.0 (flywire.ai/guidelines). Connectivity table via github.com/philshiu/Drosophila_brain_model, annotations via github.com/flyconnectome/flywire_annotations.
citations: Dorkenwald, S. et al. (2024). Neuronal wiring diagram of an adult brain. Nature 634, 124-138.
Schlegel, P. et al. (2024). Whole-brain annotation and multi-connectome cell typing of Drosophila. Nature 634, 139-152.
Shiu, P. K. et al. (2024). A Drosophila computational brain model reveals sensorimotor processing. Nature 634, 210-219.
Eckstein, N. et al. (2024). Neurotransmitter classification from electron microscopy images at synaptic sites in Drosophila melanogaster. Cell 187, 2574-2594.
caveats: Wiring, cell types and transmitters are measured or predicted from electron microscopy. Dynamics use the published leaky integrate and fire model of Shiu et al. (2024): identical neurons, weights proportional to synapse counts, sign from the predicted transmitter.
Transmitter identities are predictions. Glutamate is treated as inhibitory, as in the published model.
A subcircuit: neurons outside it are absent, so inputs they would provide are missing.

Selection: all HSE, HSN, HSS, LPLC1, LC4, LPLC2, LC16, ORN_DM1, ORN_DA2, sugar/water, bitter and DNa01, DNa02, DNa03, DNb05, DNa11, DNp01, MDN, DNp09, DNg13, DNp03, CB0701 neurons, plus neurons on paths of one or two steps between them with at least 40 synapses per step. Every synapse among the selected neurons is kept.

readouts.label: Proboscis (MN9)
readouts.description: MN9 (CB0701 in FlyWire), the motor neuron that extends the proboscis (Shiu et al. 2024).

presets.label: Taste sugar
presets.description: Stimulate the sugar sensing gustatory receptor neurons of the labellum.
presets.expected: In the whole brain model: MN9 fires and the proboscis extends (Shiu et al. 2024).

presets.label: Sugar with bitter
presets.description: Sugar and bitter receptor neurons together.
presets.expected: In the whole brain model: bitter suppresses the sugar response of MN9 (Shiu et al. 2024).

presets.label: LC16 on both sides
presets.description: LC16 activation makes real flies walk backwards (Wu et al. 2016).
